changeSummary: Lift the single-demand narrowing the MVP froze into the contract: a stop carries up to eight demands, a journey carries a stop sequence rather than exactly two legs, TO_CHARGER becomes an expressible leg type, SublotEntryRequested lists every sublot still enterable within the dispatch range instead of one, and LoadCancellationResult accepts the empty slot result that a cancellation raised before any slot operation produces.
runtimeRule: Exact ProtocolVersion and exact materialized ProtocolReleaseIdentity required; no negotiation.
optionalFieldPolicy: No optional payload fields exist in this candidate. Future optional fields require proof that omission and ignore preserve safety and business conclusions.
historyPolicy: Published tags, commits, manifests, schemas, vectors and approvals are immutable; defects require a superseding release.
